The '''Great Holocron''' was an ancient, dodecahedral [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].

==History==
Housed in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Great Holocron was the centerpiece of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] library holdings. It contained vast amounts of information that was accessible to only a Jedi Master willing to open the holocron, and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainees were encouraged to explore its contents. Despite its ease of access, consumption of its manifold mysteries was thought to be impossible&mdash;even [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was thought, by [[Jedi librarian/Legends|Archives Director]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]], to still struggle with its depth.

While the Great Holocron was designed to only reveal information that its user was prepared to encounter, inexperienced [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] accessed the Great Holocron under the watchful eye of the Archives Director who stood ready to step in if the young Jedi was drawn in too far.

Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Great Holocron was lost, probably captured by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] troopers in the [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|assault on the Jedi Temple]] during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

It was eventually rediscovered by the [[New Jedi Order]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] and placed in the library of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]] under the care of Master [[Tionne Solusar]]. She was not sure whether it was the real Great Holocron or a well-crafted replica. She would update the Holocron with data from recent eras to continue the work of former archivists before her.<ref name="TEGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Contents==
Topics included basic and advanced [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction methods, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] history, philosophy, [[Sith/Legends|Sith history]], [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] techniques. The Great Holocron also included discussions on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and methods to resist its call.

During the course of the Order's history, many Jedi contributed various scraps of information. Some of the stories and journals submitted are as follows:

*[[Arca Jeth]] on the [[Freedon Nadd Uprising]]<ref name="TEGTTF" />
*Brief mentions of the [[Ruusan campaign]].
*[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] recount of his meeting with the Sith Lords, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]].
*[[Sar Agorn]]'s view on manipulating [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
*[[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin's]] speech to a group of younglings on telepathy. Also Tiin's report on the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']].
*[[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on lightsaber combat, conquering arrogance, his resignation from the Order, and a protest to the Council after the events of the [[Battle of Baltizaar]].
*[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on farsight and the [[Chosen One/Legends|Chosen One]].
*[[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] on the dangerous aspects of [[Psychometry/Legends|psychometry]]; using the example of Padawan [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]].
*[[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis]] on [[Malacia]].
*[[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]] on [[Morichro/Legends|Morichro]].
*[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] on [[Electric Judgment]] and the [[Mission to Metellos]].
*[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] on waterproofing [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].
*[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi's]] report of the death of [[Sharad Hett]].
*[[Cin Drallig/Legends|Cin Drallig]] on the seven forms of lightsaber combat.
*[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] on [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]] and the origin of the [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]]; although the latter entry may have been propaganda by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*[[Rekpa De]] on victory and defeat.
*[[Danzigorro Potts]] reporting the death of [[Xendor]].
*[[Vima Sunrider]] on [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] redemption.
*[[Tolaris Shim]] on the four stages of the dark side.
*[[Deesra Luur Jada]] regarding the time during and following [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] reign.
*[[Reidi Artom]]'s report on the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
*[[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] in reference to the Sith Temple on [[Almas]].
*Little information on the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''.
*References to the prophecy of the Chosen One.
*[[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi's]] observations of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although not seen in the film, during production of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], the film's prop-makers made three holocrons for its [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary|Visual Dictionary]]: a Jedi holocron, a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]], and the Great Holocron.
